Out-of-network ATMs usually charge their own surcharge, which the machine should show on screen before you confirm the withdrawal. For the exact fees on your account, check the fee schedule in your Albert app or Cash account disclosures. Using an in-network ATM, such as an Allpoint location, is the best way to avoid surcharges.
